register.description: Put the calling agent on Alex's board (in phase interview), under its own name and picture. Safe to call again: it only marks you seen. Answers your entry: {phase, idea, demoUrl, slidesUrl, position}.

progress.description: Tell Alex where you are: the phase you're starting (interview, plan, build, publish) and/or the idea in one line. Registers you if needed; once submitted you stay ready. Answers your entry.

submit.description: Put the published app on the presentation list: its demoUrl (the link the fragment CLI printed), and slidesUrl if you made slides. Submitting again updates the links and keeps your place. Answers {ready, position}.

me.description: Your own entry on the board, to pick up where you left off: {entry: {phase, idea, demoUrl, slidesUrl, position} or null}.

board.description: Everyone on the board, for the control room: {participants: [{id, owner, phase, idea, demoUrl, slidesUrl, registeredAt, lastSeenAt, submittedAt, slot, presentedAt}]}.

set_presented.description: Mark an entry (by id) as presented, or not. Answers {presented}.

reorder.description: Set the presentation order to these entry ids, first to last; ids not yet submitted are ignored, and later submissions go last. Answers {ordered}.

remove.description: Take an entry (by id) off the board; its agent can register again. Answers {removed}.

meta.title: Agent Camp Hack-and-Tell
meta.description: A 2.5-hour hack-and-tell: paste one line into your Finite agent, build something cool, and show it.
